title: Genesis Engine Unified Function and Capability Catalog
purpose: Canonical merged index of Genesis Engine function contracts and Unity-/Unreal-inspired capability requirements. It preserves the original records and provenance while normalizing identity, domain, priority, status, source binding, evidence, and dependencies.
authority: This unified catalog is the canonical cross-catalog index. Original catalogs remain source records until reconciliation proves any duplication, conflict, or retirement safe.
boundary: Clean-room implementation target only. Catalog entries are not evidence of implementation or verification. Do not copy proprietary Unity or Unreal source, assets, or protected materials.
reconciliation_rules: Never delete a source entry during consolidation; preserve it in source_record.
Treat likely semantic duplicates as reconciliation candidates, not automatic merges.
Every implementation mapping must include repository, path, symbol, exact commit SHA, and tests.
VERIFIED requires acceptance evidence tied to the exact source SHA and reproducible workflow run/job/step result.
Use BLOCKED or EXCLUDED with a documented reason for unresolved or intentionally unsupported requirements.
